name: database integration checks
command:
set -o pipefail
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if docker exec marazul-db pg_isready -U portalhotel -d portal_hotel >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
docker exec marazul-db pg_isready -U portalhotel -d portal_hotel
cd backend
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5433 npm run test:integration:db
description: Aguarda o PostgreSQL e executa as seis suítes reais
